description: NSW road safety progress report is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. The NSW Government has a plan to reduce fatalities and serious injuries on NSW roads. This report outlines the actions the NSW Government took during 2017 to deliver the NSW Road Safety Strategy 2012-2021 and work towards the target of a 30 per cent reduction in fatalities and serious injuries by 2021. Coverage: NSW Government. The portal lists 7 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Government. Its tags are Transport for NSW. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence code "lsba" on the portal (not expanded on the listing). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
